capabilityStatuses.available: Implemented and supported by current product evidence, but not yet promoted through G0-LF12 qualification.
capabilityStatuses.qualified: Passed the applicable G0 Baseline Qualification and remains under permanent conformance.
capabilityStatuses.experimental: Available only for bounded development or evaluation; not a supported scientific delivery promise.
capabilityStatuses.unavailable: Not implemented, not packaged, not validated, or explicitly outside the current support boundary.

changeClasses.policy: Changes adaptive behavior inside existing contracts and safety limits.
changeClasses.compatible-contract: Adds a backward-compatible versioned contract capability.
changeClasses.migration: Changes persisted state and requires explicit upgrade and rollback behavior.
changeClasses.breaking: Changes a G0 invariant or removes compatibility and requires a new G0 major plus requalification.

projectCompatibilityStatuses.compatible: The project can execute under the current baseline.
projectCompatibilityStatuses.migration_required: The project is readable but formal writes and execution require an explicit migration.
projectCompatibilityStatuses.blocked: The project baseline is newer, unsupported, or has an identity conflict; formal writes and execution are refused.
